title: Russian — BGN/PCGN 1947
authority: US Board on Geographic Names / Permanent Committee on Geographical Names for British Official Use, 1947
description: US/UK geographic-names system (BGN/PCGN 1947), the basis of most English-language spellings: Е→YE and Ё→YË word-initially, after vowels and after Й, Ъ, Ь; Ъ→” and Ь→’. The optional interpuncts (Note 3) are not applied.
notes: Notes 1–2 are implemented. Note 3 (optional interpunct: y· for Й/Ы before А У Ы Э, ·y for Ы after vowels, ·e for Э after consonants, t·s, sh·ch) is not applied.
Ё is romanized ë/yë whether or not the source shows the dieresis; this scheme only sees Ё when it is written (Е with combining diaeresis is normalized to Ё).
Ъ is U+201D (”) and Ь is U+2019 (’) as in the BGN/PCGN document. iuliia's JSON outputs Cyrillic ё instead of Latin ë (data bug); this scheme uses Latin ë (U+00EB).
Common simplified English usage drops the apostrophes, writes ë as yo/e and -iy/-yy as -y.
